publication_policy: Research drafts only. None of these adaptations has been expert-validated; do not display to residents. Existing versioned Guidance review/publication remains authoritative.

ideas.title: Beverage bottle seed container
ideas.description: Candidate adaptation of extension seed-container advice; the source does not validate PET-specific durability or Bacoor growing conditions.
pre_handling_steps: Confirm the resin mark and contents; reject unknown history.
Use the cleaning procedure accepted by the reviewer and dry fully.
materials_and_tools: Adult-operated cutting and drainage tools, pending review
safety_notes_and_PPE: Cutting/puncturing: adult operator, stable support, eye protection and suitable hand protection; no hot tool, flame or melting.
No food/drink storage; wash hands after handling growing medium.
step_by_step: 1. Reviewer must first specify a safe cutting and drainage method for the actual bottle; do not begin while this is missing.
2. Once approved, place the prepared container on a drainage tray and add seed-starting medium.
3. Sow according to the seed packet, label, and monitor moisture without leaving standing water.
ideas.expected_result: A small seed container, not a food container.
ideas.end_of_life: Remove growing medium; ask the collector whether the modified bottle is accepted.

sources.name: University of Vermont Extension, Seed-Starting Basics
sources.section: Containers paragraph: drainage and a saucer; seed-starting medium and sowing guidance
sources.scope: General horticulture; not validation of this PET-specific adaptation

ideas.verification_gap: Exact tool procedure, container stability, local plant suitability, timing and cost need qualified review and a supervised pilot.

ideas.title: Unmodified milk jug for watering ornamental plants
ideas.description: Low-complexity reuse proposal; not permission to reuse detergent or chemical containers.
required_condition: Originally held milk or another confirmed non-hazardous beverage
pre_handling_steps: Check the mark and original label; reject unknown history.
Wash away beverage residue and dry.
safety_notes_and_PPE: No cutting, heat or added chemicals. Do not return it to food/drink use. Stop if it leaks or is brittle.
step_by_step: 1. Fill partly with water so it remains easy to hold.
2. Pour slowly onto the soil of an ornamental plant.
3. Empty and store dry, clearly identified for garden use.
ideas.end_of_life: Confirm local HDPE acceptance before collection.

ideas.verification_gap: HDPE-specific adaptation and item history require reviewer approval; no measured time or cost.

ideas.title: Reuse an intact box for a non-food gift
ideas.description: Reuse without a cutting or structural construction task.
required_condition: No grease, mold, chemicals or personal information
pre_handling_steps: Remove personal address labels without damaging the box.
safety_notes_and_PPE: Avoid staples and sharp edges; no cutting, adhesives or load-bearing use in this draft.
step_by_step: 1. Check that the gift fits without forcing the box.
2. Place the non-food gift inside with clean reused packing material.
3. Close using an existing flap or reusable tie and retain the box for reuse.
do_not_use_if: Wet, greasy, moldy, coated with unknown chemicals or weakened
ideas.end_of_life: Remove non-paper attachments and confirm local acceptance.

ideas.title: Paper wrapping for a non-food gift
ideas.description: Reuse a whole sheet instead of making pulp or using heat.
required_condition: No personal details, thermal coating, grease or mold
pre_handling_steps: Select a sheet already large enough; do not cut it in this draft.
safety_notes_and_PPE: Avoid paper cuts. Keep string away from small children and pets. No food-contact use.
step_by_step: 1. Put the non-food gift in the center of the sheet.
2. Fold the sheet around the gift.
3. Secure with the reusable string and save the paper after opening.
do_not_use_if: Wet, contaminated, coated, moldy or contains private information
ideas.end_of_life: Keep dry; ask the local collector about acceptance.

ideas.title: Use an existing fabric offcut for dry dusting
ideas.description: Repurpose fabric without sewing or cutting.
required_condition: No sharp attachments, chemical stains, mold or mildew
pre_handling_steps: Launder according to the fabric care instructions and dry.
safety_notes_and_PPE: Not for chemical spills, biological waste, food-contact cleaning or electrical equipment. No cutting or adhesives.
step_by_step: 1. Fold the offcut into a hand-sized pad.
2. Wipe an ordinary non-food, non-electrical dusty surface.
3. Launder according to its care instructions; keep dry for later use.
do_not_use_if: Mold, mildew or embedded sharp pieces
ideas.end_of_life: Ask about textile recovery; do not assume synthetic fabric is compostable.

ideas.title: Compost-bin framing (blocked research candidate)
ideas.description: Idea-level reference only. No build instructions are authorized.
required_condition: No hardware, coatings, rot, insect damage or mold
pre_handling_steps: Have a qualified reviewer inspect the wood history and condition; do not sand unknown treated wood.
safety_notes_and_PPE: Sawing, nails, splinters and dust need a reviewed design, trained adult operator, eye and suitable respiratory/hand protection. No burning. Do not start construction.
do_not_use_if: Rot, mold, hardware or insect damage
ideas.end_of_life: Ask CESD about wood recovery; never infer safe burning from a photo.
